chunks: Everything in it that is from Abū Hammām Ismāʿīl ibn Hammām, I have transmitted from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh and ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, both from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā and Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, both from Abū Hammām Ismāʿīl ibn Hammām.

key_terms.أَبِي هَمَّامٍ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ هَمَّام: The narrator to whom this transmission path leads.
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Both together; shows that paired narrators jointly transmit from the next authority.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication used here for the compiler’s father.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct reporting by the compiler through his chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū Hammām Ismāʿīl ibn Hammām in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū Hammām Ismāʿīl ibn Hammām. It serves as a technical chain clarification in hadith transmission, documenting the intermediaries between the compiler and this narrator.
